- `cli.json`: `__OCX_LAUNCHER_DEPTH` row. `reports.json`: `CleanKind` `launchers`, five reworded descriptions (`entrypoints/` to `launchers/`, launcher directories in the clean text). `vendor-manifest.json`: schema 2 (`index_digest`, `index_lookups`, `record_path`, short layout). `cli-schema.json`, `errors.json`: unchanged.
- sdkgen `types.rs`: `Launchers` variant and the same descriptions. Other sdkgen files unchanged.
- `reference/environment.md` (the `__OCX_LAUNCHER_DEPTH` row), `command-line/commands.md`, `package-consuming.md` (`shells/default-<hash>/bin`, `launchers/`, clean text). `exit-codes.md` unchanged: both launcher slugs already read right.
- Every changed line traced to a branch change; none untraceable.

## Compat gate (`the_live_goldens_hold_against_the_baseline_and_the_ledger`)
- Removing `launchers` from the golden: no violation (the baseline lacks it, so the value is an addition the gate accepts). Removing `temp`: `enum value removed at /$defs/CleanKind/x-ocx-enum/1 (B05)`. The golden byte test is what reds on a removed `launchers`.
- Real tree after the five `doc` entries: one violation left, `bump vendor-manifest schema_version to version 1 (it is 2)`. No baseline holds the vendor manifest, `version_violations` expects 1 for an absent baseline (`compat.rs` `baseline.map_or(1, ..)`), the schema says 2 (design § 4.1, R-U4). A ledger entry cannot fix it. Finding, not waived (DP-38).
